Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Copper carries the largest increase in your explanation; it sounds like recovering that cost exposure is your main concern. We want pricing that fairly supports our long-term partnership, grounded in your stated cost shares and verified index data. How can we reconcile the different index periods so the adjustment reflects your actual cost exposure?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €372.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
Please note:
CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains.
We acknowledge the verified decrease in the PPI-C241 index and your updated volume forecast, which we have factored into our calculation.
However, extending payment terms to 90 days introduces substantial financing costs that we cannot absorb.
We therefore maintain our standard 30-day payment terms and propose a revised price of EUR 368.42 per unit.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You distinguish financing costs from material costs; it sounds like you need both recognised rather than being asked to absorb either. We want a sustainable agreement that respects those pressures and reflects the verified movement in copper. How can we use that evidence to agree a measured price adjustment that supports our long-term partnership?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Copper notation for cables and motors (derived) changed -2.2% from 2026-01 to 2026-03 (idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-01, idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-03).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 365.31 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You acknowledge the copper decrease but repeatedly emphasise the remaining cost increases—it sounds like ensuring those pressures are recognised matters most. We want a fair, stable basis for our long-standing partnership, without asking you to disclose your calculation. How can we close the remaining price gap while recognising the financing burden you have identified?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Our recent orders for Motor IE3 7.5 kW, 4-pole were at 348.32 per 1 (po:4500014350-20, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014474-10). What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 366.21 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We respect that boundary and want a stable agreement supported by dependable payment. What would give you greater certainty about timely payment as we bring this to a close?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 367.27 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
